assertions.assertion: States client and API resource secrets are one-way hashed but dynamic identity provider properties such as ClientSecret are stored without hashing or Duende Storage field-level encryption
assertions.rationale: States client/API secrets are hashed on write while IdP properties like ClientSecret are not hashed and not field-encrypted.

assertions.assertion: Recommends encrypted DB connections, encryption at rest, restricted DB access and protected backups
assertions.rationale: Lists TLS to DB, encryption at rest, restricted DB access, protected backups.

assertions.assertion: Advises not to grant direct read access to the configuration store as a substitute for an authorized admin API
assertions.rationale: Says not to hand out direct read access as stand-in for an admin workflow; use IIdentityProviderAdmin.

assertions.assertion: Mentions the corresponding dynamic provider type must be registered (AddOidcDynamicProvider())
